metadata.title: Analytic study of mass segregation around a massive black hole

notes: No eligible stars. The paper is a general analytic study of mass segregation around a massive black hole. Its “unbound stars” (T:p1-b5, T:p1-b12) are stars unbound from the MBH, not stars unbound from the Milky Way. Sgr A* (T:p1-b8, T:p4-b15) is the Galactic center massive-black-hole object, not an individual stellar Galactic unbound candidate, and the illustrative stellar populations in T:p4-b15 are not individually identified stars.
